newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities market closed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities market closed.

text.p: The Singapore government securities market was closed on Friday for the Hari Raya Haji holiday.
It will reopen on Monday, April 21.

On Thursday, in treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 1.63/1.58 percent compared with Wednesday's yield of 1.60/1.55 percent and one-year at a yield of 1.70/1.65 percent against Wednesday's 1.72/1.67 percent.
Among bonds, April 1998 was unchanged from Wednesday's close of S$99.53/99.58.
September 2001 ended at S$96.67/96.72 versus Wednesday's S$96.70/96.75 and June 2003 at S$94.72/94.77 against S$94.73/94.78.
The interbank rate was unchanged from Wednesday's 3-1/2 3-3/8 percent.
